attr.title: Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider
attr.desc: Construct 2 / HTML5 build of Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider on a bundled aarch64 WPE WebKit runtime rendered straight to the framebuffer (mali-fbdev). Requires the user's own game assets. Tested only on Anbernic RG40xx H / muOS 2508.4 LOOSE GOOSE.
attr.inst: After installing the BYO package, copy the unchanged contents of your legitimate desktop/Electron game export to the moonrider/game directory. Required: index.html, c2runtime.js, data.js, images/, media/, CSV files and the intro MP4. The launcher injects the maintained audio/gamepad patches automatically.
attr.inst_md: After installing the BYO package, copy the unchanged contents of your legitimate desktop/Electron game export to `moonrider/game/`. Required: `index.html`, `c2runtime.js`, `data.js`, `images/`, `media/`, CSV files and the intro MP4. The launcher injects the maintained audio/gamepad patches automatically.
